 Vernon Bailey @ RivalsVernon 11/02/26 0 Share Share West Virginia guard Martin Somerville - Credit: WVU Basketball A bad pass can sometimes be the result of a mistake a player made several seconds earlier.
West Virginia head coach Ross Hodge believes a lot of passing problems start with players putting themselves in bad situations, especially when they're driving toward the basket.
